title: Do Not Restart: Residual Completion for Stateful Agent Handoffs
abstract: arXiv:2609.13800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Routing and cascades reduce tool-agent cost by transferring control across models, but stateful handoffs must preserve accepted choices, realized effects, and unfinished obligations. We formulate this as commitment-constrained residual completion and introduce Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC). CFRC enforces target-before-proposal, whole-proposal-before-authority, and live-evidence-before-success: it freezes a residual contract from accepted progress, closes the successor continuation into an evidence-linked graph, and admits execution only when the remainder is covered, with live receipts discharging obligations. We establish contract-relative partial correctness, which extends to the original residual request under complete contract construction. translated_title: 不要重启：面向有状态智能体交接的剩余任务补全
translated_abstract: 路由与级联技术通过在模型间转移控制权来降低工具智能体的成本，但有状态的交接必须保留已被接受的选择、已实现的效应以及未完成的义务。我们将这一问题形式化为承诺约束下的剩余补全，并提出了承诺边界剩余补全方法（Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion, CFRC）。CFRC 强制执行“先目标后提案、先完整提案后授权、先实时证据后判定成功”的原则：它从已接受的进展中冻结出一份剩余契约，将后继的延续过程封闭为一个证据关联的图，并且仅当剩余部分被完全覆盖时才允许执行，同时以实时回执来解除相关义务。我们建立了契约相对的部分正确性，该正确性在完整契约构造下可扩展至原始的剩余请求。在五个环境和两组同提供商模型对的实验中，CFRC 仅以强大的全任务智能体 22.0%–34.6% 的推理成本，取得了相当的宏平均准确率……
tldr: 本文提出承诺边界剩余补全（CFRC）框架，使智能体交接时无需重启即可在契约约束下完成剩余任务，仅以 22.0%–34.6% 的推理成本达到与全任务智能体相当的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC), a commitment-constrained framework that enables stateful agent handoffs without restarting, achieving accuracy comparable to strong full-task agents at only 22.0%–34.6% of their inference cost.
